title: Reachability
prompt: Given `commits` — a map of id → parent id (null for root) — and a target id, return an array of ALL ancestor ids reachable from the target (including itself), ordered oldest-first (walk to root, then reverse).

tests.name: walks parents to the root
tests.hint: Follow the parent chain collecting ids, then reverse.

tests.name: handles roots and unknown links
tests.hint: Stop when parent is null or the id is missing from the map.
